lookaheads_from_audit.signal: query-time signal copied into every historical stacker row (feature column 13)
lookaheads_from_audit.regime: lam_short/prior_short chosen once per machine from total observed spins before the cutoff (nobs < 100), so old rows see the machine's final coverage
lookaheads_from_audit.prior: expert log-prior = argmax of each fit machine's FINAL log-likelihood; historical rows of that machine therefore see its own future

fixes.signal_head: historical rows omit column 13; signal re-enters only through a query-time head: logistic regression (C=1.0, lbfgs) on fit-split QUERY rows with inputs [stacker logit, signal one-hot] -> P(win), replacing the stacker's P(win) at prediction
fixes.running_regime: lam/prior regime switches on observed spins so far at each tick (seen < 100), for state updates and features alike
fixes.crossfit_prior: historical rows use an expert log-prior learned from fit-split machines in OTHER episode groups (4 deterministic groups by sorted episode id); prediction uses the prior from all fit machines (same as champion)

variants.parity: copied core with all fixes off; must equal champion within 1e-12 (correctness gate, not a result)
variants.causal_all_nohead: running_regime + crossfit_prior, no signal anywhere in the stacker
variants.regime_only: running_regime only (signal kept as in champion)
variants.prior_only: crossfit_prior only (signal kept as in champion)

evaluations.A: fit on TRAIN, official score_round on VALIDATION (development-exposed), paired episode bootstrap vs champion
evaluations.R: #8 registry, 4 condition-stratified whole-episode train folds, sampled-label Brier, research.metrics.paired vs champion

expected: causal_all within about 0.2 official points of the champion (HE-03/HE-17 found signal ~0.1 and the regime/prior issues small); R difference not distinguishable from 0
decision_rule: No promotion by this study. 'Defensible drop-in' if A is within 0.25 points of the champion and the R interval includes 0 or favours causal_all; promotion remains a human/lane-A decision.
